options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Anuri Pearlstone shuffle
options.doc:
Determines where Anuri Pearlstones can be placed.
- **Vanilla**: Places Anuri Pearlstones at their vanilla location
- **Own Dungeon**: Places Anuri Pearlstones shuffled within their dungeon
- **Anywhere**: Anuri Pearlstones can be found across the multiworld
options.doc_fr:
Détermine l'emplacement des pierres angulaires d'Anuri.
- **Vanilla**: Place Anuri Pearlstones à leur emplacement de vanille
- **Own Dungeon**: Places Anuri Pearlstones serré dans leur donjon
- **Anywhere**: Anuri Pearlstones peut être trouvé à travers le multimonde

options.name: Ouro Guard Key shuffle
options.doc:
Determines where Ouro Guard Keys can be placed.
- **Vanilla**: Places Ouro Guard Keys at their vanilla location
- **Own Dungeon**: Places Ouro Guard Keys shuffled within their dungeon
- **Anywhere**: Ouro Guard Keys can be found across the multiworld
options.doc_fr:
Détermine où les clés Ouro Guard peuvent être placées.
- **Vanilla**: Placer les clés de la Garde Ouro à leur emplacement vanille
- **Own Dungeon**: Les clés de la Garde d'Ouro se trouvent dans leur donjon
- **Anywhere**: Les clés de la Garde d'Ouro se trouvent dans le monde entier

options.name: Keep status upgrades and moonstones in item pool when locations are excluded
options.doc:
When enabled, Heart rubies, Energy gems and Moonstones will stay in the item pool if not included. Filler items are placed at the disabled locations.
When disabled, these items can be acquired at their vanilla locations.
Warning: disabling this setting is incompatible with certain other settings as these items are required in the pool
